package domain

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

const (
	LearningPathPlanningStateSchema = "student-learning-path-planning-state.v1"
	LearningPathReplanRequestSchema = "student-learning-path-replan.v1"
	LearningPathNoGapRequestSchema  = "student-learning-path-no-gap.v1"
	LearningPathCommandResultSchema = "student-learning-path-command-result.v1"
)

type LearningPathPlanningCommandKind string

const (
	LearningPathPlanningCommandReplan LearningPathPlanningCommandKind = "REPLAN"
	LearningPathPlanningCommandNoGap  LearningPathPlanningCommandKind = "NO_GAP"
)

type LearningPathPlanningState struct {
	Schema               string             `json:"schema"`
	StudentID            string             `json:"student_id"`
	LearningPathID       string             `json:"learning_path_id"`
	CourseID             string             `json:"course_id"`
	GoalCode             string             `json:"goal_code"`
	CourseFingerprint    string             `json:"course_fingerprint"`
	Status               LearningPathStatus `json:"status"`
	IsPrimary            bool               `json:"is_primary"`
	IsSelected           bool               `json:"is_selected"`
	PathVersion          int64              `json:"path_version"`
	JourneyVersion       int64              `json:"journey_version"`
	PlannerPolicyVersion string             `json:"planner_policy_version"`
	ReasonCode           string             `json:"reason_code"`
	ReasonSummary        string             `json:"reason_summary"`
	Items                []LearningPathItem `json:"items"`
	UpdatedAt            time.Time          `json:"updated_at"`
}

type LearningPathPlanningCommand struct {
	Schema               string
	Kind                 LearningPathPlanningCommandKind
	StudentID            string
	LearningPathID       string
	PlanningRequestID    string
	IdempotencyKey       string
	CourseID             string
	GoalCode             string
	CourseFingerprint    string
	PlannerPolicyVersion string
	ReasonCode           string
	ReasonSummary        string
	ExpectedPathVersion  int64
	DesiredItems         []LearningPathItem
	RequestHash          string
	OccurredAt           time.Time
}

type LearningPathPlanningCommandResult struct {
	Schema            string                          `json:"schema"`
	PlanningRequestID string                          `json:"planning_request_id"`
	Command           LearningPathPlanningCommandKind `json:"command"`
	Changed           bool                            `json:"changed"`
	State             LearningPathPlanningState       `json:"state"`
}

func NormalizeLearningPathPlanningCommand(input LearningPathPlanningCommand) (LearningPathPlanningCommand, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.LearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningPathID)
	input.PlanningRequestID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlanningRequestID)
	input.IdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(input.IdempotencyKey)
	input.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseID)
	input.GoalCode = normalizeOnboardingCode(input.GoalCode)
	input.CourseFingerprint = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseFingerprint)
	input.PlannerPolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlannerPolicyVersion)
	input.ReasonCode = normalizeOnboardingCode(input.ReasonCode)
	input.ReasonSummary = strings.TrimSpace(input.ReasonSummary)
	input.RequestHash = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.RequestHash))
	input.OccurredAt = input.OccurredAt.UTC()
	if !validJourneyUUID(input.StudentID) || !validJourneyUUID(input.LearningPathID) ||
		!validJourneyUUID(input.PlanningRequestID) || !validJourneyUUID(input.IdempotencyKey) ||
		!validJourneyUUID(input.CourseID) || input.ExpectedPathVersion < 1 || input.GoalCode == "" ||
		len(input.GoalCode) > 64 || input.CourseFingerprint == "" || len(input.CourseFingerprint) > 128 ||
		input.PlannerPolicyVersion == "" || len(input.PlannerPolicyVersion) > 64 || input.ReasonCode == "" ||
		len(input.ReasonCode) > 64 || input.ReasonSummary == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(input.ReasonSummary) > 500 ||
		input.OccurredAt.IsZero() || !validLearningPathRequestHash(input.RequestHash) {
		return LearningPathPlanningCommand{}, errors.New("invalid learning path planning command")
	}
	switch input.Kind {
	case LearningPathPlanningCommandReplan:
		if input.Schema != LearningPathReplanRequestSchema || len(input.DesiredItems) < 1 || len(input.DesiredItems) > 500 {
			return LearningPathPlanningCommand{}, errors.New("invalid learning path replan command")
		}
		items, err := NormalizePlannerDesiredLearningPathItems(input.DesiredItems)
		if err != nil {
			return LearningPathPlanningCommand{}, err
		}
		input.DesiredItems = items
	case LearningPathPlanningCommandNoGap:
		if input.Schema != LearningPathNoGapRequestSchema || input.ReasonCode != "mastery_no_gap" || len(input.DesiredItems) != 0 {
			return LearningPathPlanningCommand{}, errors.New("invalid learning path no-gap command")
		}
	default:
		return LearningPathPlanningCommand{}, errors.New("invalid learning path planning command kind")
	}
	return input, nil
}

func NewLearningPathPlanningState(
	path StudentLearningPath,
	contextValue StudentLearningContext,
) (LearningPathPlanningState, error) {
	normalizedPath, err := NormalizeStudentLearningPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return LearningPathPlanningState{}, err
	}
	normalizedContext, err := NormalizeStudentLearningContext(contextValue)
	if err != nil || normalizedContext.Version < 1 || normalizedContext.StudentID != normalizedPath.StudentID {
		return LearningPathPlanningState{}, errors.New("invalid learning path planning context")
	}
	return LearningPathPlanningState{
		Schema: LearningPathPlanningStateSchema, StudentID: normalizedPath.StudentID,
		LearningPathID: normalizedPath.ID, CourseID: normalizedPath.CourseID, GoalCode: normalizedPath.GoalCode,
		CourseFingerprint: normalizedPath.CourseFingerprint, Status: normalizedPath.Status,
		IsPrimary: normalizedPath.IsPrimary, IsSelected: normalizedContext.SelectedLearningPathID == normalizedPath.ID,
		PathVersion: normalizedPath.Version, JourneyVersion: normalizedContext.Version,
		PlannerPolicyVersion: normalizedPath.PlannerPolicyVersion, ReasonCode: normalizedPath.ReasonCode,
		ReasonSummary: normalizedPath.ReasonSummary, Items: normalizedPath.Items, UpdatedAt: normalizedPath.UpdatedAt,
	}, nil
}

func NormalizeLearningPathPlanningState(input LearningPathPlanningState) (LearningPathPlanningState, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.LearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningPathID)
	input.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseID)
	input.GoalCode = normalizeOnboardingCode(input.GoalCode)
	input.CourseFingerprint = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseFingerprint)
	input.PlannerPolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlannerPolicyVersion)
	input.ReasonCode = normalizeOnboardingCode(input.ReasonCode)
	input.ReasonSummary = strings.TrimSpace(input.ReasonSummary)
	input.UpdatedAt = input.UpdatedAt.UTC()
	path, err := NormalizeStudentLearningPath(StudentLearningPath{
		ID: input.LearningPathID, StudentID: input.StudentID, CourseID: input.CourseID,
		GoalCode: input.GoalCode, CurriculumRevision: input.CourseFingerprint,
		PolicyVersion: LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: input.PlannerPolicyVersion,
		ReasonCode: input.ReasonCode, ReasonSummary: input.ReasonSummary, Status: input.Status,
		IsPrimary: input.IsPrimary, IsSelected: input.IsSelected, Version: input.PathVersion,
		Items: input.Items, CreatedAt: input.UpdatedAt, UpdatedAt: input.UpdatedAt,
	})
	if err != nil || input.Schema != LearningPathPlanningStateSchema || input.JourneyVersion < 1 ||
		(input.IsSelected && input.Status != LearningPathStatusActive) {
		return LearningPathPlanningState{}, errors.New("invalid learning path planning state")
	}
	input.GoalCode = path.GoalCode
	input.Items = path.Items
	return input, nil
}

func NormalizeLearningPathPlanningCommandResult(
	input LearningPathPlanningCommandResult,
) (LearningPathPlanningCommandResult, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.PlanningRequestID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlanningRequestID)
	state, err := NormalizeLearningPathPlanningState(input.State)
	if err != nil || input.Schema != LearningPathCommandResultSchema || !validJourneyUUID(input.PlanningRequestID) ||
		(input.Command != LearningPathPlanningCommandReplan && input.Command != LearningPathPlanningCommandNoGap) {
		return LearningPathPlanningCommandResult{}, errors.New("invalid learning path planning result")
	}
	input.State = state
	return input, nil
}

func ReconcilePlannerLearningPathItems(
	current StudentLearningPath,
	desired []LearningPathItem,
) ([]LearningPathItem, bool, error) {
	normalizedCurrent, err := NormalizeStudentLearningPath(current)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, false, err
	}
	normalizedDesired, err := NormalizePlannerDesiredLearningPathItems(desired)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, false, err
	}
	// Completed occurrence identities, positions and revisions are immutable.
	// Check before candidate validation so protected mutations return conflict.
	for _, existing := range normalizedCurrent.Items {
		if existing.Status != LearningPathItemCompleted {
			continue
		}
		found := false
		for index, item := range normalizedDesired {
			if learningPathItemIdentity(item) == learningPathItemIdentity(existing) {
				if item.Position != existing.Position || item.ReferenceType != existing.ReferenceType ||
					item.ReferenceID != existing.ReferenceID || item.LessonRevisionID != existing.LessonRevisionID ||
					(item.ID != "" && item.ID != existing.ID) {
					return nil, false, ErrConflict
				}
				normalizedDesired[index] = existing
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return nil, false, ErrConflict
		}
	}
	candidate := normalizedCurrent
	candidate.Items = normalizedDesired
	normalizedCandidate, err := NormalizeStudentLearningPath(candidate)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, false, err
	}
	existingByReference := make(map[string]LearningPathItem, len(normalizedCurrent.Items))
	for _, item := range normalizedCurrent.Items {
		existingByReference[learningPathItemIdentity(item)] = item
	}
	var preservedReadyKey string
	for index := range normalizedCandidate.Items {
		item := &normalizedCandidate.Items[index]
		existing, ok := existingByReference[learningPathItemIdentity(*item)]
		if ok && existing.Status == LearningPathItemCompleted {
			// Preserve the whole authoritative history, including satisfaction,
			// targets, content and reason, regardless of Planner-supplied values.
			*item = existing
			continue
		}
		if ok && existing.ID != "" {
			if item.ID == "" && existing.LessonRevisionID == "" {
				item.ID = existing.ID
			}
			if item.LessonRevisionID != existing.LessonRevisionID {
				return nil, false, ErrConflict
			}
			item.FrozenRequirements = append([]LessonRequirement(nil), existing.FrozenRequirements...)
			item.LessonContent = append([]byte(nil), existing.LessonContent...)
		}
		if !ok || learningPathItemStatusRank(existing.Status) <= learningPathItemStatusRank(item.Status) {
			continue
		}
		if item.ID != "" && item.LessonRevisionID != existing.LessonRevisionID {
			return nil, false, ErrConflict
		}
		item.LessonRevisionID = existing.LessonRevisionID
		item.FrozenRequirements = append([]LessonRequirement(nil), existing.FrozenRequirements...)
		item.LessonContent = append([]byte(nil), existing.LessonContent...)
		item.Status = existing.Status
		item.ReasonCode = existing.ReasonCode
		item.Targets = append([]LearningTargetRef(nil), existing.Targets...)
		if existing.Status == LearningPathItemReady {
			preservedReadyKey = learningPathItemIdentity(existing)
		}
	}
	if preservedReadyKey != "" {
		for index := range normalizedCandidate.Items {
			item := &normalizedCandidate.Items[index]
			if item.Status == LearningPathItemReady && learningPathItemIdentity(*item) != preservedReadyKey {
				item.Status = LearningPathItemPlanned
			}
		}
	}
	normalizedCandidate, err = NormalizeStudentLearningPath(normalizedCandidate)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, false, err
	}
	return normalizedCandidate.Items, !reflect.DeepEqual(normalizedCurrent.Items, normalizedCandidate.Items), nil
}

// ApplyPlannerLearningPathReplan builds the next exact Student-owned path
// revision. The URL path identity and version are the current-state
// precondition; Course identity and desired items belong to the replacement.
func ApplyPlannerLearningPathReplan(
	current StudentLearningPath,
	command LearningPathPlanningCommand,
) (StudentLearningPath, bool, error) {
	path, err := NormalizeStudentLearningPath(current)
	if err != nil {
		return StudentLearningPath{}, false, ErrValidation
	}
	command, err = NormalizeLearningPathPlanningCommand(command)
	if err != nil || command.Kind != LearningPathPlanningCommandReplan {
		return StudentLearningPath{}, false, ErrValidation
	}
	if path.StudentID != command.StudentID || path.ID != command.LearningPathID ||
		path.Version != command.ExpectedPathVersion ||
		(path.Status != LearningPathStatusActive && path.Status != LearningPathStatusPaused) {
		return StudentLearningPath{}, false, ErrConflict
	}
	items, itemsChanged, err := ReconcilePlannerLearningPathItems(path, command.DesiredItems)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrConflict) {
			return StudentLearningPath{}, false, ErrConflict
		}
		return StudentLearningPath{}, false, ErrValidation
	}
	structural := itemsChanged || path.CourseID != command.CourseID || path.GoalCode != command.GoalCode ||
		path.CourseFingerprint != command.CourseFingerprint
	if structural {
		for _, item := range path.Items {
			if item.Status == LearningPathItemInProgress {
				return StudentLearningPath{}, false, ErrConflict
			}
		}
	}
	changed := itemsChanged || path.CourseID != command.CourseID || path.GoalCode != command.GoalCode ||
		path.CourseFingerprint != command.CourseFingerprint || path.PlannerPolicyVersion != command.PlannerPolicyVersion ||
		path.ReasonCode != command.ReasonCode || path.ReasonSummary != command.ReasonSummary
	if !changed {
		return path, false, nil
	}
	path.CourseID = command.CourseID
	path.GoalCode = command.GoalCode
	path.CurriculumRevision = command.CourseFingerprint
	path.CourseFingerprint = command.CourseFingerprint
	path.Items = items
	path.PlannerPolicyVersion = command.PlannerPolicyVersion
	path.ReasonCode = command.ReasonCode
	path.ReasonSummary = command.ReasonSummary
	path.Version++
	path.UpdatedAt = command.OccurredAt
	path, err = NormalizeStudentLearningPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return StudentLearningPath{}, false, ErrValidation
	}
	return path, true, nil
}

func NormalizePlannerDesiredLearningPathItems(input []LearningPathItem) ([]LearningPathItem, error) {
	if len(input) < 1 || len(input) > 500 {
		return nil, errors.New("invalid desired learning path items")
	}
	items := make([]LearningPathItem, len(input))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input))
	readyCount := 0
	for index, item := range input {
		item.ReferenceType = normalizeOnboardingCode(item.ReferenceType)
		item.ReferenceID = strings.TrimSpace(item.ReferenceID)
		item.ReasonCode = normalizeOnboardingCode(item.ReasonCode)
		targets, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRefs(item.Targets)
		if err != nil || (item.ReferenceType != "lesson" && item.ReferenceType != "practice") ||
			!validJourneyUUID(item.ReferenceID) || item.Position != index ||
			(item.Status != LearningPathItemPlanned && item.Status != LearningPathItemReady) ||
			item.ReasonCode == "" || len(item.ReasonCode) > 64 {
			return nil, errors.New("invalid desired learning path item")
		}
		identity := learningPathItemIdentity(item)
		if _, exists := seen[identity]; exists {
			return nil, errors.New("duplicate desired learning path item")
		}
		seen[identity] = struct{}{}
		if item.Status == LearningPathItemReady {
			readyCount++
		}
		item.Targets = targets
		items[index] = item
	}
	if readyCount > 1 {
		return nil, errors.New("multiple desired ready learning path items")
	}
	return items, nil
}

func validLearningPathRequestHash(value string) bool {
	decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
	return err == nil && len(decoded) == 32
}

func learningPathItemIdentity(item LearningPathItem) string {
	if item.ID != "" && item.LessonRevisionID != "" {
		return "item:" + item.ID
	}
	return item.ReferenceType + ":" + item.ReferenceID
}

func learningPathItemStatusRank(status LearningPathItemStatus) int {
	switch status {
	case LearningPathItemPlanned:
		return 0
	case LearningPathItemReady:
		return 1
	case LearningPathItemInProgress:
		return 2
	case LearningPathItemCompleted, LearningPathItemSkippedMastered:
		return 3
	default:
		return -1
	}
}

// GuardLearningPathPlanningMutation protects authoritative completed history
// and the ordinary boundary shared by exact replan and legacy replacement.
// Both paths must be normalized before calling it. It does not grant consent
// or implement the hybrid evaluation policy.
func GuardLearningPathPlanningMutation(current, replacement StudentLearningPath) error {
	for _, existing := range current.Items {
		if existing.Status != LearningPathItemCompleted {
			continue
		}
		preserved := false
		for _, item := range replacement.Items {
			if learningPathItemIdentity(item) == learningPathItemIdentity(existing) && reflect.DeepEqual(item, existing) {
				preserved = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !preserved {
			return ErrConflict
		}
	}
	structural := current.CourseID != replacement.CourseID || current.GoalCode != replacement.GoalCode ||
		current.CourseFingerprint != replacement.CourseFingerprint || current.Status != replacement.Status ||
		!reflect.DeepEqual(current.Items, replacement.Items)
	if structural {
		for _, item := range current.Items {
			if item.Status == LearningPathItemInProgress {
				return ErrConflict
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}
